source: A Rails locale file starts with the locale code as its top-level key. The preset reads the messages under that key, so the keys do not start with the locale:
text: Rails 的语言文件以语言代码作为顶层 key。该预设读取此 key 下的消息，因此这些 key 不以语言代码开头：
